data.name: Hedra
data.detailed_description:
Ready or not, here they come!

At the Large Hadron Collider, a team of physicists pushes an experiment a little too far and opens a portal into another dimension. Behold!  The Hedra come pouring through: hungry, bad-tempered, interdimensional polyhedral monsters led by rival Overlords. You are one of those Overlords! Seize the collider, complete your objectives, eat the physicists, and escape before the whole facility tears itself apart.

Hedra is the digital edition of an original physical board game developed and refined over ten years. It brings tile laying, dice combat, card play, unique spatial pattern building, and tactical movement to a board that grows differently every game.

The digital edition handles the setup, rules, bookkeeping, and CPU turns (your computer opponents are very, very nasty, btw...), leaving you to concentrate on the wonderfully strange puzzle spreading across the table.

Build the collider as you play

Place Room Tiles to expand the facility one piece at a time. Every placement changes the routes across the collider and may complete one of your Room Pattern cards. A completed pattern can score Victory Points or bring a new Hedra die onto the board, giving you an immediate choice between points and power.

The digital tile supply contains 216 Room Tiles:

  • 80 triangles, where new Hedra dice enter the collider

  • 80 squares, where physicists can be found and consumed

  • 28 hexagons, which supply Hedra Fight cards

  • 16 octagons, which reveal Hedra Effects

  • 10 dodecagons, which interact with Facility Effects

  • 2 icosagons, rare rooms capable of major upgrades

The shapes tessellate in unusual ways, so a promising pattern can emerge from a tiny gap, a long chain of rooms, or a tile your opponent placed for entirely different reasons. There are 72 Room Pattern cards to chase, ranging from compact arrangements to sprawling geometric projects.

Grow monsters. Eat scientists (Hedra love scientists... they're delicious!).

Your Hedra are represented by polyhedral dice: d4s, d6s, d8s, d12s, and d20s. Move them through the collider, consume physicists to grow into larger forms, and send them into rooms occupied by enemy Hedra.

Fights account for die size, current health, room effects, and the cards played during combat. The game includes 32 Hedra Fight cards, 32 Hedra Effect cards, and 32 Facility Effect cards, giving each match plenty of opportunities for clever timing and sudden trouble.

Every Overlord has a plan

Ten Hedra Overlord cards provide endgame goals tied to patterns, room shapes, and control of the collider. Your Overlord can turn an ordinary-looking position into a valuable long-term project, while the other Overlords pursue plans of their own.

Play solo against one to five computer-controlled rivals. CPU Overlords can use different strategic approaches, including pattern building, aggressive movement, immediate scoring, combat, Overlord objectives, and the dangerous rush for an icosagon.

Get out before it blows

Once an Overlord reaches the Victory Point threshold, the collider enters a self-destruct countdown. Everyone gets a few final turns to complete patterns, start fights, consume physicists, grab last-minute points, and reach the Lobby. The board starts coming apart. There is still time to win.

Features

  • Solo strategy play against one to five CPU Overlords

  • A shared board assembled from six different polygon shapes

  • 216 Room Tiles and 72 geometric Room Pattern cards

  • Polyhedral Hedra that grow from d4s into powerful d20s

  • Tile placement, tactical movement, card play, combat, and endgame objectives

  • Ten Overlord cards with their own scoring priorities

  • A 3D tabletop presentation with tabletop and overhead views

  • A guided tutorial, in-game rules reference, and save-and-resume support

  • Based on a physical board game refined over ten years

  • Second-place winner in the KublaCon Game Design Contest

This game is not available yet as an actual physical board game. I have a few copies of it that I've made. Maybe one day it will be. If you're an interested publisher, don't hesitate to reach out.

data.short_description: A scientific blunder tears open a portal, and the Hedra pour through. Build a shifting collider from six tile shapes, grow monster dice, complete patterns, battle rival Overlords, and devour physicists in this solo digital board game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible integrated or dedicated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and OS, mouse and keyboard, 1100 x 720 display. Compatibility 2D mode is available.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core, 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050, RX 560, Intel Iris Xe, or equivalent with WebGL 2
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Mouse and keyboard, 1920 x 1080 display, hardware acceleration enabled for Premium 3D.
